svg.title: Frameshift: a -1 deletion changes every downstream codon; a nearby +1 restores the frame
svg.text: Reading frame arithmetic: codons are counted from the start, three by three
Invented 30-nt coding sequence. Red: changed codon or amino acid. Grey: after the first stop, not translated.
Codon numbers are counted in the new sequence. Deletion: red bar. Insertion: green base.
Net length change modulo 3 decides: 0 keeps the frame, 1 or 2 shifts every codon downstream of the change.
